{"$settings": {"autoescape": true}, "text": "<b>", "number": 3}
---
tilde plain: {{ text ~ "&" }}
tilde safe: {{ (text|safe) ~ text ~ number ~ none }}
tilde safe last: {{ text ~ (text|safe) }}
plus safe str: {{ (text|safe) + text }}
plus str safe: {{ text + (text|safe) }}
plus safe safe: {{ (text|safe) + ("&"|safe) }}
times: {{ (text|safe) * 2 }} {{ 2 * (text|safe) }} {{ text * 2 }}
percent: {{ ("<%s>"|safe) % text }} {{ ("%s|%r"|safe) % (text, text) }} {{ ("%d<"|safe) % number }}
percent mapping: {{ ("%(a)s"|safe) % {"a": text} }}
percent truncate: {{ ("%.2s"|safe) % text }}
plain percent: {{ "<%s>" % (text|safe) }}
